diagnostics.message: aws_cloudwatch_event_target.syncer can be created, and the scheduled EventBridge rule can fire, before aws_lambda_permission.syncer has granted events.amazonaws.com permission to invoke the Lambda. The target should wait for the Lambda permission.

aws_lambda_function.syncer is created in parallel with aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.syncer_vpc_execution_role. When lambda_subnet_ids is non-empty, Lambda requires AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole to be attached to the execution role in order to create ENIs during function creation, so the function should depend on the VPC execution role attachment.
